Thanks for confirming interest. We want to lock a compact virtual full-loop on Wednesday, Oct 6 for Alex (UTC-7). Below is a proposed multi-slot slate and panel sequencing to keep total interview time under 4.5 hours while preserving a solid systems deep dive and product pairing slot.

Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- 09:00-09:40 — Intro + Product pairing (Hiring PM + Eng manager)
- 09:50-10:40 — Systems design (Senior Staff Eng)
- 10:50-11:20 — Coding exercise (pairing, timed)
- 11:30-12:00 — Leadership / culture conversation (Director)
- 12:10-12:30 — Closing / compensation Qs (Recruiter)

Attachments: resume, agenda draft, debrief rubric (stubs attached).

Requesting:
- Panel owners: please confirm your slot ownership or propose swaps by EOD Monday (Sep 28).
- Candidate: share final availability for Oct 6 (the slots above), and confirm timezone (I have you down as PDT). If any of the above blocks are tight, we can compress coding and systems into a single 90m block but would prefer the separations above.

Logistics:
- We will use a single meeting room per slot; links will be sent after we confirm.
- Please complete the short calibration rubric immediately after your slot (link/drive doc in final email).

Thanks — Priya
